description: Explicitly save, replace or forget this account's private diner memory. Notes must contain 1–500 Unicode characters, including emoji; the service enforces this limit. Requires separate diner_write consent, not implied by read. Use expectedRevision from the account holder or diner_memory; ask before replacing their writing. Free; never orders anything. Returns acknowledgement only, never note contents. Deleting your note: This removes it from the diner’s current records. Older backups may still contain it, and restoring a backup could bring it back. Copies already shared with an AI agent, chat service or anyone else aren’t deleted here.

note.description: 1–500 Unicode characters, including emoji. The service enforces 500 characters; the 1000 code-unit ceiling accommodates emoji.
